Dogecoin (DOGE) - is an open source peer-to-peer digital currency. It is considered both the first "meme coin", and, more specifically, the first "dog coin."

Unlike other cryptocurrencies, Dogecoin has no maximum supply.

Discover #Dogecoin #DOGE 🚪👇
https://t.co/BMZnJzUL2x https://t.co/U1spjd6Bd5

Dogecoin developers rolled out offline #DOGE transactions using radio technology combined with SpaceX’s Starlink satellite network.

Dogecoin was successfully delivered 100 miles from its origin through radio transmission using the RadioDoge protocol 🚀
